editor.name: Nermin Sefić
editor.bylinePolicy: Individual author only on sourced, demonstrably authored material. Automatic agent content must not impersonate personal author.
editor.disclosure: AI-assisted when used; identify publisher separately.

seo.title: Unique, descriptive, native language; brand as editorial publisher
seo.pageLanguage: Native language body, not translated boilerplate only
seo.canonical: Only a verified real live URL; self-canonical per unique original page
seo.hreflang: Only genuinely equivalent translated pages, reciprocal and validated
seo.sitemap: Only verified 200 indexable pages, no staging or future pages
seo.schema: NewsMediaOrganization as publisher, Article author actual authenticated author or organization, Nermin Sefić editor only unless proven as author
seo.social: Open Graph and Twitter cards with owned or licensed landscape image
seo.images: Unique illustration or licensed original, descriptive localized alt, source attribution and rights
seo.hashtags: Contextual limited distinct tags for user-facing distribution; do not hide large hashtag blocks in body or meta keywords
seo.backlinks: Only relevant editorial cross-links between genuine editions; never thin doorway/link farms
seo.searchPolicy: Google Search Central spam policies and multi-regional guidelines

external.cloudflarePages: Free plan only, respect account quota and one-concurrent-build cap
external.githubActions: No GNK ASG self-imposed minute cap; account's free runner eligibility and billing block still apply
